title: Post-Phase 1 backlog — expose ticket comments through MCP
objective: Post-Phase-1 deferred backlog. Depends on Phase 1 completion/merge under P1-05 ticket #57; do not implement as part of current Phase 1 completion.

acceptance_criteria.text: MCP exposes append and read of timestamped ticket comments without replacing existing comments or modifying ticket lifecycle fields implicitly.
Comment operations validate ticket identity and body size, preserve audit/index synchronization, and have tests for append, readback, concurrent writers, and malformed input.
Once released, new handoffs use MCP comments and the temporary CLI append-comment exception is removed from the workflow; historical comments and tests.cases remain intact.

needed: Implement and test MCP comment append/read after Phase 1; verify audit/index synchronization and concurrency.
